requirements.title: Implementá add.js con una función que sume dos números y add.test.mjs usando node:test

reviewer: Reviewed add.js, add.test.mjs, and package.json. reviewer-evidence: package.json:2 — "type": "module"
reviewer-evidence: package.json:4 — "test": "node --test add.test.mjs"
reviewer-evidence: npm test: 3 tests, 3 pass, 0 fail, EXIT_CODE=0
